events.body:
## Context

README lists `.github/workflows/update-catalog.yml` and `update-profiles.yml` (the jobs are `.forkmesh/blt-ossh--*.yml`), says `cd BLT-OSSH`, and describes profiles as GitHub Issues; ARCHITECTURE.md says GitHub Actions.

## What to do

1. Rewrite those sections for the forge and .forkmesh; use `cd BLT/blt-ossh`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every path in the tree exists
- [ ] Setup steps work verbatim

## How to test locally

```bash
Follow the README.
```

---
